tagline.zh: document.startViewTransition(cb) 对旧/新状态分别截图,再以 CSS 动画驱动快照过渡:整页交叉淡化是平台默认,view-transition-name 命名元素可做共享元素 morph。
tagline.en: document.startViewTransition(cb) snapshots the old and new states, then drives the snapshots with CSS animation: a whole-page cross-fade is the platform default, and naming elements with view-transition-name enables shared-element morphs.

origin.zh: CSS View Transitions Level 1 + 同文档 DOM API:机制为旧/新拍照→冻结渲染并更新 DOM→CSS 动画过渡快照(Chrome 官方文档,调研 04§3.1/3.2)。时长/缓动默认取官方 same-document 页 Material shared-axis 示例主段数值:300ms + cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)(调研 04§3.2)。
origin.en: CSS View Transitions Level 1 + the same-document DOM API: the mechanism snapshots old/new, freezes rendering while the DOM updates, then animates the snapshots (Chrome docs, research 04 §3.1/3.2). Duration/easing defaults take the main segment of the official same-document page's Material shared-axis example: 300ms + cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) (research 04 §3.2).

effect.zh: 过渡时长,经 ::view-transition-group/old/new 的 animation-duration 覆写生效。默认 300ms 取 Chrome 官方 Material shared-axis 示例主段时长(调研 04§3.2);平台内置交叉淡化的默认时长调研未记载,不作官方标注。调大过场更从容,调大过 500ms 开始拖沓;调小至 150ms 以下接近直切。
effect.en: Transition duration, effective via the animation-duration override on ::view-transition-group/old/new. Default 300ms takes the main segment of Chrome's official Material shared-axis example (research 04 §3.2); the platform cross-fade's own default was not recorded in the research, so no official claim is made. Larger = more leisurely (past 500ms it drags); below 150ms it nears a hard cut.

effect.zh: 过渡缓动,经同组伪元素的 animation-timing-function 覆写。默认 (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 取官方 Material shared-axis 示例主段曲线(调研 04§3.2)——与 MUI 沿用的 M2 standard easeInOut 同值。morph 模式下该曲线同时作用于位置/尺寸的补间。
effect.en: Transition easing, effective via the same pseudo-elements' animation-timing-function. Default (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) takes the main-segment curve of the official Material shared-axis example (research 04 §3.2) — the same value as MUI's inherited M2 standard easeInOut. In morph mode the same curve also drives the position/size tween.

effect.zh: JS 型参数:morph=被点卡片与详情主图携带同一 view-transition-name(可为不同 DOM 节点——过渡期间动态赋名即可),::view-transition-group 自动过渡位置/宽高(官方共享元素过渡,调研 04§3.2);fade=不命名,退化为整根 root 的交叉淡化(平台默认过渡)。名字必须同时唯一,否则整个过渡被跳过(官方警告)。
effect.en: JS-typed param: morph = the clicked card and the detail hero carry the same view-transition-name (they may be different DOM nodes — assign the name dynamically during the transition), and ::view-transition-group tweens position/size automatically (the official shared-element transition, research 04 §3.2); fade = no naming, degrading to a root-wide cross-fade (the platform default). Names must be unique at all times or the whole transition is skipped (official warning).

note.zh: 同文档过渡(document.startViewTransition):Chrome/Edge 111+、Safari 18+、Firefox 144+(Chrome 文档表格,调研 04§3.1);跨文档 @view-transition:Chrome 126+、Safari 18.2+(Firefox preview,BCD,调研 02§D6)。demo 仅演示同文档;无 API 时直切不过渡。
note.en: Same-document transitions (document.startViewTransition): Chrome/Edge 111+, Safari 18+, Firefox 144+ (Chrome docs table, research 04 §3.1); cross-document @view-transition: Chrome 126+, Safari 18.2+ (Firefox preview, BCD, research 02 §D6). The demo covers same-document only; without the API it switches with no transition.

browserSupport.baseline: Newly available (Chrome 111+ / Safari 18+ / Firefox 144+ for same-document)

fallback.zh: 无 document.startViewTransition 或 prefers-reduced-motion 时直接切换状态(不做任何过渡)——过渡只是包装,内容照常可达;同一时刻只允许一个视图过渡,新过渡开始时旧过渡直接跳到结尾(官方行为,demo 不排队);回调可返回 promise(官方建议 Promise.race 限 100ms),demo 的 DOM 更新是同步 flushSync,无需等待。
fallback.en: Without document.startViewTransition or under prefers-reduced-motion the state switches directly (no transition) — the transition is only a wrapper and content stays reachable; only one view transition may run at a time and a new one skips the old to its end (official behavior, the demo does not queue); the callback may return a promise (official advice: Promise.race within 100ms), but the demo's DOM update is a synchronous flushSync and needs no waiting.

use.zh: SPA 状态/路由切换的兜底动画:列表→详情、标签页切换(同文档 API,调研 04§3.1)
use.en: Fallback animation for SPA state/route changes: list→detail, tab switches (same-document API, research 04 §3.1)

use.zh: 共享元素 morph:缩略图展开为大图、导航持久元素跟随(名字唯一 + group 自动补间,调研 04§3.2)
use.en: Shared-element morphs: thumbnail expanding to a hero, persistent nav elements tracking (unique name + automatic group tween, research 04 §3.2)

use.zh: 时长/缓动全部可覆写——所有动画都是 CSS 动画(官方强调),可按品牌统一曲线
use.en: Duration/easing fully overridable — every transition animation is a CSS animation (officially emphasized), so brand curves apply uniformly

use.zh: 进入/退出差异化:::view-transition-old/new(name):only-child 分别定义(官方示例,调研 04§3.2)
use.en: Asymmetric enter/exit: define ::view-transition-old/new(name):only-child separately (official example, research 04 §3.2)

avoid.zh: 给多个元素同名 view-transition-name——过渡整体被跳过(官方唯一性警告,调研 04§3.2)
avoid.en: Giving several elements the same view-transition-name — the whole transition is skipped (official uniqueness warning, research 04 §3.2)

avoid.zh: 把过渡当关键信息载体——不支持/关闭动效的环境必须能无过渡完成同一操作
avoid.en: Treating the transition as a carrier of key information — unsupported or motion-reduced environments must complete the same action without it

avoid.zh: 在过渡回调里做超长异步等待——官方建议 100ms 内(官方文档,调研 04§3.2)
avoid.en: Long async waits inside the transition callback — keep it within 100ms per the official docs (research 04 §3.2)

avoid.zh: 跨文档场景误用同文档 API——MPA 走 @view-transition 声明且无 JS API(Chrome 126+/Safari 18.2+,Firefox 未支持,调研 04§3.1)
avoid.en: Using the same-document API across documents — MPA uses the declarative @view-transition with no JS API (Chrome 126+/Safari 18.2+, unsupported in Firefox, research 04 §3.1)

a11y.zh: 视图过渡是整页级位移,前庭影响最大:prefers-reduced-motion 时必须直切(demo 内建);操作结果不得依赖过渡呈现(不支持环境直切且功能完整);morph 的位置补间遵循用户系统设置;过渡期间渲染被冻结,回调要短(官方 100ms 建议)以免输入停顿。
a11y.en: View transitions are page-scale motion with the largest vestibular impact: they must hard-cut under prefers-reduced-motion (built into the demo); outcomes must never depend on the transition (unsupported environments hard-cut with full functionality); morph tweens follow the user's system setting; rendering is frozen during the transition, so keep callbacks short (official 100ms advice) to avoid input stalls.

goal.zh: 用 document.startViewTransition 实现列表→详情的同文档过渡:morph 模式给被点卡片与详情主图赋同名 view-transition-name 做共享元素补间,fade 模式退化为整页交叉淡化;时长/缓动用参数快照覆写伪元素动画。
goal.en: Implement a list→detail same-document transition with document.startViewTransition: in morph mode assign the same view-transition-name to the clicked card and the detail hero for a shared-element tween; in fade mode degrade to a root cross-fade; override the pseudo-element animations with the duration/easing snapshot.

acceptance.zh: 时长/缓动严格使用快照值覆写 ::view-transition-group/old/new
acceptance.en: Duration/easing strictly use the snapshot values overriding ::view-transition-group/old/new

acceptance.zh: morph 模式下同一时刻只有一个元素持有该 view-transition-name(唯一性警告)
acceptance.en: In morph mode only one element holds the view-transition-name at any time (uniqueness warning)

acceptance.zh: 不支持 startViewTransition 或 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时直接切换状态,功能不损失
acceptance.en: Without startViewTransition or under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, switch state directly with zero functional loss

acceptance.zh: DOM 更新在过渡回调内同步完成(React 用 flushSync),回调不做长等待
acceptance.en: The DOM update completes synchronously inside the transition callback (flushSync in React) with no long waits
